Fleetwood Town v Tranmere Rovers (Kick-off 5.30pm). Coverage of the League Two match at Highbury Stadium. The corresponding clash here last season finished in a 0-0 draw, the second season in a row that these teams produced a goalless stalemate at this stadium. The hosts had been struggling in the league before the start of the month, but after their historic League Cup victory over Arsenal they then picked up three points four days later thanks to a 3-1 win over Bristol Rovers.

Celtic v Rangers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the top-flight match at Kirkintilloch Community Sports Complex. These teams last faced each other at Broadwood Stadium in September when the Blue Belles were comfortable 5-2 winners in a game that initially saw the Ghirls take a 1-0 lead through Maria McAneny. Jodi McLeary bagged a double to ensure Rangers went into half-time with a two-goal lead, and while Chloe Arthur equalised in the second-half, further goals from Hannah Blake, Katie Wilkinson, and Calliste Brookshire put the result beyond doubt.

West Ham United v Charlton Athletic (Kick-off 2.00pm). Coverage of the top-flight match at Chigwell Construction Stadium. These teams faced each other just over two weeks ago in a Subway Players Cup league-phase match at The Valley, and it was the Irons who came out on top in a 2-1 victory inspired by a fist-half brace from Welsh international Ffion Morgan, while Grace Johnston pulled one back for the Addicks in the second half.
